label: SB-19 new call shapes: client-streaming upload and pipelined bidi (contract section 3.2)
methodology: server cells only: each server peer under test driven by the fixed native open-loop Poisson generator (rpc-bench `load`), one discarded warmup probe then 3 measured repeats at the frozen offered rate. Validation stage: pass means the cell ran, every offered call reconciles (offered == successful + failed + rejected), and no repeat is generator-capped (SB-11 client-CPU signal or rejections); no SLO gate and no leadership threshold here. Claim-grade runs need contract section 6 statistics (5+ paired runs, 15 s warmup, 60 s measurement) via SB-22, which re-freezes rates after a pilot. Cell order is frozen: peers in file order x cells in file order.

cells.note: contract primary: client streaming 1 KiB x 2000 msgs; runs via load --shape=client_stream

contract section 3.2 pipelined full-duplex (async interleaved, NOT lockstep); FROZEN but unrunnable at this base: load bidi is lockstep ping-pong only, so the runner reports unsupported with the exact missing capability instead of mislabeling a lockstep run
